<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

# Shape enforcing the requirement TRF‑035 clause 4.1.1:
# “L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society.”
# L is represented by the property vocab:ruleLength whose value must be a
# qudt:QuantityValue with a numeric value (decimal) and the unit metre.

vocab:ShipRuleLengthShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:ruleLength ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;            # the value must be a node (QuantityValue)
        sh:node [
            a sh:NodeShape ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
                sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
                sh:minCount 1
            ] ;
            sh:property [
                sh:path qudt:unit ;
                sh:hasValue unit:M ;
                sh:minCount 1
            ]
        ]
    ] .
<END_SHACL>

The task: produce SHACL shape that captures the requirement TRF-035 clause 4.1.1: “L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society.”

Given ontology terms: ruleLength (object property linking benchmarkEntity to QuantityValue), classificationSocietyRuleLength (object property?). Actually classificationSocietyRuleLength is a QuantityProperty: domain benchmarkEntity, range QuantityValue. So we need shape that expects for each ship, a property ruleLength (or perhaps classificationSocietyRuleLength?) The requirement says L is the rule length used by classification society. There are two properties: ruleLength (general) and classificationSocietyRuleLength (quantitative). We need to model that L must be provided and must be equal to classificationSocietyRuleLength? The requirement just defines L as that. So SHACL may enforce that ruleLength property exists, and optionally that its value is a QuantityValue with unit m, numeric decimal.

Also maybe include classificationSocietyRuleLength as the source of L. But we just need shape to enforce that for any ship node, there is ruleLength property linking to a qudt:QuantityValue with unit M and numeric.

We also have classificationSociety (string) property maybe not needed.

The SHACL graph must use exact IRIs, the quantityEncoding numeric_predicate/unit_predicate: numericValue and unit.

Thus shape: sh:targetClass ship (owner_class). Provide property shapes: ruleLength - sh:path vocab:ruleLength ; sh:qualifiedValueShape with node kind sh:NodeShape requiring that the object is a qudt:QuantityValue with sh:property constraints: numericValue of datatype xsd:decimal, unit = qudt:unit/M .

Similarly for classificationSocietyRuleLength? The requirement maybe wants to enforce classificationSocietyRuleLength holds the same as ruleLength. Could add a constraint that if both present they must be same quantity. But not required.

We must not invent missing owners. Ownership mapping given: owners for these properties are ship, which matches target class.

Thus shape:

<https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ShipRuleLengthShape> a sh:NodeShape; sh:targetClass <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship>; sh:property [ sh:path <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ruleLength>; sh:minCount 1; sh:nodeKind sh:IRI; sh:node [ a sh:NodeShape; sh:property [ sh:path <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue>; sh:datatype xsd:decimal; sh:minCount 1 ]; sh:property [ sh:path <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit>; sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M>; sh:minCount 1 ] ] ] .

Also could add classifications: classificationSocietyRuleLength similar.

But requirement only defines L, perhaps ruleLength is L. classificationSocietyRuleLength is separate concept: the rule length used by classification society. So ruleLength property maybe overall rule length? The requirement says L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society. So ruleLength is that value. So we just enforce ruleLength.

Thus final SHACL graph. Need to include prefixes? Not required but optional. Provide full Turtle.

Also include import of SHACL namespace.
